column1: 一款面向 Friday Night Funkin' 及其衍生引擎的模组管理器，负责模组的识别、安装、启动、浏览、备份与外观定制。以下为功能说明。
column2: A mod manager for Friday Night Funkin' and its derivative engines: it identifies, installs, launches and browses mods, backs up saves and restyles the UI. Here is what it does.

column1: 软件会自动扫描识别目录，每个文件夹即一个模组，图标取该文件夹下的 icon.ico。引擎与版本通过结构特征、exe 字符串签名和版本锚点三重判断。模组支持分类、隐藏、置顶与重命名，排序方式可在名称、最近启动、引擎之间切换；重命名会直接改动磁盘上的目录名，并同步迁移分类、置顶、作者、游玩记录等配置。可为模组创建桌面与开始菜单快捷方式，网页版条目支持自定义图标。把文件夹或压缩包（.zip / .rar / .7z）拖进主窗口，即可添加或安装。
column2: The launcher scans the mods folder: each folder is one mod and its icon comes from icon.ico inside it. Engine and version are decided three ways — folder structure, exe string signatures and version anchors. Mods can be categorized, hidden, pinned and renamed; sorting switches between name, recent launch and engine. Renaming changes the directory on disk and carries the category, pin, author and playtime config along with it. Mods can get desktop and Start menu shortcuts, and web entries accept a custom icon. Drag a folder or an archive (.zip / .rar / .7z) into the window to add or install it.

column1: 压缩包安装会自动识别内部结构，剥掉外层多余的文件夹，只安装真正的那一层。判断依据是最浅一层的 exe；若没有 exe，则看 lime.ndll、mods/pack.json 或 modsList.txt。.zip 由内置解压处理，.rar / .7z 借用本机 Bandizip、7-Zip 或 WinRAR 的命令行；遇到其他格式会直接提示不支持。安装前可给模组起名（同时作为文件夹名），目标已存在时会询问是否合并覆盖。压缩包与文件夹两种安装方式都有进度窗，可中途取消并自动清理残留。
column2: Archive installs detect the inner structure automatically: redundant outer folders are stripped and only the real root is installed, judged by the shallowest exe — or, with no exe, by lime.ndll, mods/pack.json or modsList.txt. .zip uses the built-in extractor; .rar / .7z call the local Bandizip, 7-Zip or WinRAR command line, and other formats are rejected outright. You can name the mod before installing (the name doubles as the folder name); if the target exists you are asked whether to merge and overwrite. Both install paths show a cancellable progress window and clean up leftovers.

column1: 双击、回车、点「启动游戏」或按 Ctrl+1~9 均可启动前九个模组。启动前会做体检，路径含中文、目录不完整或 exe 丢失都会提示。启动后可自动隐藏到系统托盘，游戏退出时自动恢复窗口；关闭确认小窗提供「隐藏到托盘 / 直接退出」，可记住选择，也可连带关闭游戏。
column2: Double-click, Enter, the “Launch game” button or Ctrl+1~9 all launch the first nine mods. A pre-flight check warns about non-ASCII paths, incomplete folders or a missing exe. The launcher can hide to the tray after launch and restore its window when the game exits; the close prompt offers “Hide to tray / Exit”, can remember your choice and can close the game too.

column1: 每次启动都会记录时间、模组、引擎、退出码与耗时，点标题栏的「日志」可查看、复制、清空。异常退出时自动弹出崩溃分析，把退出码与目录特征翻译成可能原因。软件单实例运行，并支持导出诊断信息。
column2: Every launch records the time, mod, engine, exit code and duration; “Logs” in the title bar shows, copies and clears them. Abnormal exits raise a crash analysis that turns the exit code and folder layout into likely causes. The launcher runs as a single instance and can export diagnostics.

column1: 合听会把伴奏与人声预混成一个缓存文件，用系统播放器打开，不会出现不同步；伴奏、人声也可单独播放，只有合并音轨的歌曲会提示无法拆分。
column2: The mix option premixes instrumental and voices into one cached file and opens it in your system player, so the tracks can never drift; instrumental and voices can also play on their own, and only merged tracks are reported as unsplittable.

column1: 曲目列表显示 BPM、难度倍率、音轨类型（人声+伴奏 / 合并）与时长，疑似原版条目可折叠。预览为大图窗口，支持左右切换、双击全屏。资料页包含故事线/周、成就、资源构成（图片 / 音频 / 脚本比例条）、引擎与文件信息以及主题色。Lua 脚本管理会列出 scripts、custom_events、custom_notetypes，可查看、添加、删除。
column2: The song list shows BPM, difficulty multiplier, track type (voices+instrumental / merged) and length, and likely-vanilla entries can be collapsed. Preview is a large-image window with left/right switching and double-click fullscreen. The details page covers story/weeks, achievements, asset breakdown (images / audio / scripts bars), engine and file info plus the theme color. Lua management lists scripts, custom_events and custom_notetypes for viewing, adding and deleting.

column1: 启动模组前自动备份存档，保留最近 5 份，资料窗内可一键还原。清理功能覆盖启动器缓存（模组信息）、引擎日志、试听缓存与旧存档备份。
column2: Saves are backed up automatically before each launch, the newest 5 are kept, and the details window restores them in one click. Cleanup covers the launcher cache (mod info), engine logs, the audio cache and old save backups.

column1: 整套界面采用 PCL 式规则：单一色相 8 级色阶，切换强调色时标题栏、卡片、描边会一起偏色。窗口为自绘：无系统边框与标题栏，8px 圆角，标题栏渐变配字标与自绘的 − □ ×；拖边缩放、拖标题栏移动、双击最大化均为自实现，不依赖系统厚边框。导航按钮收进标题栏，左侧底部是大号「启动游戏」，详情区拆成「基本信息 / 运行统计」两张卡，搜索框为圆角自绘（聚焦变强调色，含放大镜与占位提示）。
column2: The whole interface follows PCL-style rules: one hue in 8 levels, so switching the accent shifts the title bar, cards and outlines together. The window is fully custom-drawn: no system border or title bar, 8px corners, a gradient header with the wordmark and hand-drawn − □ ×; edge resizing, title-bar dragging and double-click maximizing are all hand-rolled and need no thick frame. Navigation sits in the title bar, the big “Launch game” button lives bottom-left, details split into “Basic info / Run stats” cards, and the search box is a rounded custom control (accent on focus, with magnifier and placeholder).

column1: 外观可自定义主色（色相条）、背景图与三档浓淡（跨控件拼接对齐），窗口背景可压暗；另有 6 种预设强调色、启动动画，并支持 Ctrl +/- 缩放界面。所有外部跳转（网页、资源管理器）做了 1.2 秒去重，不会一次打开两个。
column2: Appearance offers a custom accent (hue bar), a background image and three strength presets that align across controls, with an optional dimmed background; there are also 6 accent presets and a launch animation, and Ctrl +/- zooms the UI. All external jumps (web pages, Explorer) are de-duplicated for 1.2 s so two windows never open at once.
